proof_groups.proof_strategy: Prove the five general len obligations in manual order. Open xizi_dll to initialize done=nil and todo=nodes. For each loop step, unfold the nonempty suffix xizi_dllseg, fold the two fields into xizi_dll_links, move the current node into the prefix with a segment-snoc argument, and retain the remaining segment. For the general transition, derive Zlength(before)+2 < 2^32 from the disjoint aligned pointer stores via store_ptr_align4, store_align4_merge, and store_align4_n_valid, then rewrite unsigned_last_nbits with that bound; the first transition has counter 0 and needs only the trivial 0<=1<2^32 bound. On exit, equal-boundary xizi_dllseg forces todo=nil and the predecessor endpoint equality; append the last processed node and use xizi_dll_close, while the zero-iteration branch folds the empty circular node. Keep all reusable facts local to witness proof bodies unless a group-local case_lib declaration is truly necessary. Do not use any forbidden lemma, in particular derivable1_refl or logic_equiv_sepcon_comm; use structured predicate unfold/fold, Intros/Exists, sep_apply, cancellation, and entailer instead.
proof_groups.grouping_reason: These witnesses are the initialization, two transition shapes, and two exit shapes of the same xizi_double_link_len invariant. They share the same DLL predicates, segment endpoint facts, length equations, and local proof vocabulary; keeping them together lets one worker carry one coherent invariant proof route. The group has 5 witnesses, below the controller maximum of 12.

Substitute first=tmp_node=linklist_pre, use the equal-boundary segment to obtain todo=nil and the predecessor equality, derive nodes=nil and linklist_length=0, then fold the empty xizi_dll.

proof_groups.proof_strategy: For the wrapper return witness, unfold xizi_double_link_init_then_len_result, use retval=0, and preserve the incoming xizi_dll(head,nil); discharge the emp alternative analogously. For the specialization derivation, instantiate nodes_general=nil, allocate the existing xizi_dll resource to the general precondition, prove the residual wand structurally, and inside the wand instantiate retval=0; Zlength nil=0 turns the general result equality into the nil-case result while preserving the consumed xizi_dll resource. No duplication of spatial resources and no new public premise is needed. Do not use any forbidden lemma, in particular derivable1_refl or logic_equiv_sepcon_comm; construct the wand with the separation-logic introduction tactic and finish by structured Intros/Exists/cancellation and predicate preservation.
proof_groups.grouping_reason: Both witnesses concern only the nil-case specialization and the real wrapper callsite, not loop traversal. They share the ret=0 simplification and xizi_dll(head,nil) preservation pattern, while having no proof dependency on the loop-invariant group.
